other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding calculates category counts over the combined train and test datasets, which leaks the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The solution implements a reasonable cross-validated pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost, but it introduces critical data leakage by fitting SVD and calculating frequency encodings on the combined train and test dataset. Furthermore, the agent combines the model predictions using a naive, equal-weight ensemble without tuning.
